paragraphs.source_zh: “啊，原来如此。不过，阿龟小姐也已到了嫁人的年龄了。对方是谁？”

paragraphs.source_en: “They say it is the Okudaira family, lords of Tsukude Castle, though no one yet knows whether they are friend or foe... Young Attendant, compared with Kame, I suppose I am fortunate.”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lady, please rest for a while.”
